articles.summary: Without governed action, agencies risk building AI that generates more insight without improving the work or, worse, accelerates inconsistent or opaque decisions.
articles.title: How AI Can Help Governed Mission Action

articles.summary: If an agency's own content relies on stale PDFs, complicated navigation, or writing that AI systems can’t easily parse into a direct answer, the AI will likely look elsewhere and cite something else.
articles.title: Agencies must address their AI discoverability gaps

articles.summary: According to new research from ICF and MeriTalk, the biggest challenge comes not from the technology itself but in redesigning workflows to make AI effective at scale.
articles.title: The Agentic Future: Are federal agencies prepared for what’s ahead?
